title: Just do it!
text: What a wonderful day! Our Moroccan guide was incredibly friendly and had us all laughing—such a joy! It still feels like a dream to us. While it is indeed a long day, I highly recommend this excursion for an unforgettable experience.

title: Book the tour
text:

Really a jammed packed day but worth seeing everything we could in 1 day.

author: jessicamS5098ER

title: Great experience!
text: Great day trip to see Tangier. The guides were great, it is a lot to fit into one day with travel and customs.  So be well rested the day before your trip.  Special shout out to Pia our travel guide and companion, she made the trip absolutely enjoyable.
author: Brett S

title: Visit Tangier Morocco/ Africa: Check
text:
What to expect:
We always felt safe: Tour guides from Spain Laura & Tangier are w/ you the whole time. Except the 30mins of free time in the market. There will be people approaching you  all the time to buy stuff throughout. Always say No 1st & walk away as a bargaining tactic. Euros are accepted. 
Expect a long day: You might get back to your hotel late based on ferry being late ( they did customs to Tangier on ferry) & or traffic. We arrived back at hotel past midnight. Bring snacks & drinks. There was a charging port on the Mercedes bus to & from Tarifa.

author: Ryan_E

title: A glimpse of Tangier
text:
This is an all day excursion. It was worth it. The spanish guide, and the   marroccan guide were amazing. Rajid was the name of the guide in Tangier. He was great. I don't remember the Spanish girl. 
Beautiful trip. 
The camel part was kind of sad. The camels are in a parking lot and they kind of take you in a loop for 20 seconds. 
The driver was bad in Spain. I do not recommed sitting on the back of the van or you will jump around a lot, lol. 
Overall felt safe, cared for, and a nice glimpse of Tangier.
author: Maria_T

title: Amazing!!!!!
text: Beautiful history city!!!! Great views and nice lunch. Best tour guide Rashid in Tangier and Jose Luis from Seville!!!.
author: mariadelourdesg173

title: Tangier from Seville in a day
text: We had a fabulous time with our Spain guide Jose Luis who made this trip amazing.  He was there from the very start in Spain-Morocco-spain, with a great consideration and constant smile.  He watched out for us from the very beginning to end, and gave us a driving tour too.  We went one way there and another way back.  We had a separate Morocco guide too, who also spoke great English.  Would recommend this trip.
author: Annie_N

title: Tangier day trip from seville
text: We took a day trip to tangier with Jose Luis, and it was the best!  We have travelled extensively with private guides mostly, and generally stayed away from group tours.  However, Jose Luis made u feel like part of his family.  He was punctual and so very considerate.  He watched out for us, and was there to guide us from the pick up point in Spain, taking the ferry with us to Morocco for the day, back and then dropping us off.
